## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 77 captures during March 2023. Activity proceeded as planned, with session lists managed in accordance with the routine operating arrangements. Routine leave was accommodated during the reporting period and did not prevent the scheduled work from being completed. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 77 captures, 8 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 10.4 per cent. The result indicates that most captures were suitable for assessment, although the ungradable images should continue to be monitored through routine quality review. Any recurring issues identified through that review can inform subsequent session preparation and image capture practice.

## Grading

There were 11 referable results during March 2023. The median grading lag was 1 days. Grading activity was therefore completed within the recorded operational timeframe, subject to the usual variation between individual results. Overall, the site maintained planned activity while recording the image-quality and grading outcomes set out in this report.
